sloka: एते हि दयिता राज्ञः पितुर् दशरथस्य मे ।एतैः सुविहितैः अश्वैः भविष्याम्य् अहम् अर्चितः ॥२-५०-४६॥
transliteration: ete hi dayitā rājñaḥ pitur daśarathasya me ।etaiḥ suvihitaiḥ aśvaiḥ bhaviṣyāmy aham arcitaḥ ॥2-50-46॥

translations.english: "These horses were dear to my father, king Dasaratha; if they are well tended, I shall be honoured by them."
